title: Pangilinan presses VP witness on ex-law partner’s Duterte Youth ties

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-Judge Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan pressed a defense witness in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on his former law partner’s connection to the Duterte Youth Party-list. Lawyer and certified public accountant Rainer Dela Fuente confirmed his partnership withEdward Gialogo, but he said he had no personal knowledge of the lawyer’s work for the party-list. Dela Fuente, a former Anti-Money Laundering Council employee now in private practice, was presented by the defense to discuss anti-money laundering standards and financial investigations.
